name: Denmark

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in Denmark: 22.7% in 2023 and 22.5% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); all plastics together, no separate figure for PET bottles

steel.recycling_rate: SOURCE: steel packaging recycled in Denmark: 61.7% in 2023 and 78.1% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); the two years differ by more than 10 points

pet.incineration_share: SOURCE: municipal waste in Denmark in 2024: 2325 kt incinerated with or without energy recovery and 88 kt landfilled, so 96% of what is not recycled is incinerated (Eurostat env_wasmun, table updated 15 October 2026); prior centred at 95%
